description: Extractive summary (TextRank, offline) — Summarize any text by picking its most central sentences verbatim - TextRank over TF-IDF sentence similarity, fully offline and deterministic (no AI, so nothing is invented and results are repeatable). Returns the summary, the chosen sentences with their positions and scores, compression ratio and the top-ranked sentences. Optional: sentences (1-30, default 5) or ratio (0-1), query= to bias toward a topic. Up to 100,000 chars. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. The Federal Reserve held interest rates steady on Wednesday. Officials said inflation remains elevated but has eased over the past year. Mr. Powell noted that the labor market is still strong. Markets rallied after the announcement. Analysts expect the first rate cut in early 2027. Bond yields fell as traders priced in cuts.

name: text_extractive_summary
